_readme: The stickman-video-director runtime the night job renders with (kaomei/stickman-video-director, MIT). Pinned to one commit: a new upstream version is adopted only by changing this file, which changes the look fingerprint (scripts/skill_hash.py) and asks the owner for a new approval.

disabled_styles.A1: Director mode: writes prompts for Gemini Omni Flash video clips (paid API, no key)
disabled_styles.A2: Director mode: Gemini Omni Flash (paid API, no key)
disabled_styles.A3: Director mode: Gemini Omni Flash (paid API, no key)
disabled_styles.A4: Director mode: Gemini Omni Flash (paid API, no key)
disabled_styles.A5: Director mode: Gemini Omni Flash (paid API, no key)
disabled_styles.A6: Amber Noir: reference-guided Gemini images + Gemini Puck narration (paid API, no key)
disabled_styles.B5: Character Explainer: needs an image-generation tool for the presenter (paid API, no key)
disabled_styles.B6: Dynamic Meme: needs painted story stills from an image tool (paid API, no key)
disabled_styles.B4: Survival Thriller: its style lock requires an image-generation tool that takes the B4 anchor images as references (paid API, no key)

owner_decision_2026-11-15: No paid image or video API. Only the styles the runtime can draw with code run: B1, B2, B3 (disclosed as best effort, not sample-equivalent). Each style is approved once from a demo; the job picks the style by content. A1-A6, B4, B5, B6 switch on when a key is added.
